# HubSpot System Playbook
**System:** HubSpot CRM
**Maturity:** stub — not yet implemented
**Last updated:** 2026-05-12
**Clients using this playbook:** zyris

---

## Status
Stub created by Scout (Zyris engagement). Enriched by Architect after design, completed by CO after delivery.

## Known quirks (pre-design)
> **CRITICAL (FK-013):** MuleSoft SE stated "no pre-built HubSpot connector" on Zyris sales call (Feb 17 2026). Connector registry shows `mule-hubspot-connector 1.0.0` with `configTemplate: http-generic-config.xml` — suggesting a thin wrapper or recently added connector. **Verify on Anypoint Exchange before committing to native connector in decisions.json.** Confirm: (a) Is this MuleSoft-certified or community? (b) Which operations are supported (List/Get/Search/Create/Update contacts and companies, webhook subscription)? (c) Does it support OAuth 2.0 client credentials?

> **AUTH:** HubSpot supports Private App tokens (Bearer token) or OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code. For server-to-server MuleSoft integrations, **Private App token** is simpler and sufficient — no OAuth dance required. Scopes required: `crm.objects.contacts.read`, `crm.objects.contacts.write`, `crm.objects.companies.read`, `crm.objects.companies.write`.

> **PAGINATION (FK-006):** HubSpot uses cursor-based pagination. API returns `paging.next.after` in response body — pass as `after` query param on next request. `limit` max is 100 per call. For bulk sync: use recursive sub-flow pattern (FK-006 recommendation for < 1000 records per run).

> **RATE LIMITS:** 100 requests / 10 seconds per access token (private app). Batch endpoints available for bulk reads — prefer batch APIs for scheduled sync.

> **MERGE EVENTS:** HubSpot fires webhook events on record merges: `contact.merge` and `company.merge`. Payload includes

## Known quirks (pre-design)
 `objectId` (winner/final record) and `propertyName: hs_merged_object_ids` (loser record IDs). External IDs from loser records must be extracted and stamped to winner.

> **LIFECYCLE STAGES (Zyris-specific):** Sync to D365 FO only triggers on specific HubSpot lifecycle stages — confirm which stages qualify (e.g. `customer`, `opportunity`). "Modified since last run" watermark uses HubSpot `hs_lastmodifieddate` property.

> **WEBHOOK SIGNATURE:** HubSpot sends `X-HubSpot-Signature` header for webhook security validation. MuleSoft experience API must verify this signature before processing.

> **PATCH NOTE (FK-005 applies):** If native connector lacks PATCH support for specific HubSpot entities, use HTTP connector fallback with manual token management. Token TTL for HubSpot Private App tokens: no expiry (static) — caching not required, but good practice.
